run_executeShTest: run executeShTest to execute an LLVM/Clang integrated test script with optional external shell and extra substitutions
parse_integratedTestScript: parse an LLVM/Clang style integrated test script to extract RUN, XFAIL, REQUIRES, and UNSUPPORTED directives
run_executeScriptInternal: run executeScriptInternal to execute shell commands via Python's subprocess without an external shell
run_executeScript: run executeScript to execute shell commands via an external bash or cmd.exe shell
run_executeBuiltinDiff: run executeBuiltinDiff to compare two files or directories line by line with options like -w, -b, -u, -r
